# Remove doublets

```{r}
clusters_to_keep <- so_T@meta.data$clusters_T %>% unique() %>% .[-6]
so <- subset(so_T %>% set_idents("clusters_T"), ident = clusters_to_keep)
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% plot_umap(color_str = "nFeature_RNA") 
```

# Rerun Seurat workflow

```{r}
so <- run_seurat_rna_workflow(so)
```

# Clustering 

```{r}
for (res in seq(0.2, 0.8, 0.1)) {
    so <- FindClusters(so, resolution = res)
}
```

```{r, fig.asp = 1, fig.width = 7}
clustree::clustree(so, prefix = "RNA_snn_res.")
```

```{r, fig.asp = 1, fig.width = 7}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    dplyr::select(cell, umap_1, umap_2, all_of(str_subset(colnames(.), "RNA_snn_res."))) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(str_subset(colnames(.), "RNA_snn_res.")), 
                 names_to = "clustering", 
                 values_to = "cluster") %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "cluster", x = umap_1, y = umap_2, label = TRUE, label_groups = "clustering") + 
    facet_wrap(~clustering, ncol = 3)
```

# Assign clusters

```{r}
cluster_ann_df <- readxl::read_excel(file.path(results_dir, "cluster_annotations.xlsx")) %>% 
    tidyr::fill(Subset, clustering) %>% 
    filter(Subset == "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets.rds") %>% 
    filter(clustering == "RNA_snn_res.0.4") %>% 
    mutate(cluster_ID_name = paste0(cluster, ": ", cluster_ID))

cluster_key <-
    cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_name %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster)
cluster_grouped_key <-
    cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_grouped %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster)

palette_cluster <- cluster_ann_df$color %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_name)

cluster_ID_name_ordered <- cluster_ann_df %>% 
    arrange(cluster_ID_grouped) %>% 
    .$cluster_ID_name
```

```{r}
cell_type_metadata <- get_metadata_from_so(so, metadata = "RNA_snn_res.0.4", reduction = NULL) %>%
    mutate(clusters_T = cluster_key[as.character(RNA_snn_res.0.4)]) %>% 
    mutate(clusters_T = factor(clusters_T, levels = cluster_ID_name_ordered)) %>% 
    mutate(general_T_subtypes = cluster_grouped_key[as.character(RNA_snn_res.0.4)]) %>% 
    select(-RNA_snn_res.0.4) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("cell")
so <- AddMetaData(so, metadata = cell_type_metadata)
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so, metadata = "clusters_T") %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "clusters_T", label = TRUE, pointsize = 0.5, 
              repel_min_segment_length = 0.1, 
              x = umap_1, y = umap_2) + 
    theme(legend.position = "none") + 
    scale_color_manual(values = palette_cluster)
```

# Dot plot marker

```{r}
genes <- c(
    "Cd44", # 11/8 meeting with Brian, he suggested adding it
    "Cd4", "Cxcr6", "Icos", # Cd4
    "Cd8a", "Cd3e", #"Ccl5", # Ccl5-high
    "Gzmk", "Tox", # Gzmk high
    "Pdcd1", "Havcr2", "Lag3", # Exh
    "Il1rl1", "Gata3", # ILC2 
    "Trdc", # gdT
    "Ifit1", "Isg15", # IFN-sensing
    "Sell", "Il7r", "Tcf7", # Naive
    "Klra4", "Klre1", # NK
    "Mki67", "Stmn1",  # Prolif
    "Ikzf2", "Foxp3", "Ctla4" # tregs
)

dotplot_df <-
    get_metadata_from_so(so,
                         metadata = "clusters_T",
                         genes = genes,
                         reduction = NULL) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = 3:ncol(.),
                 names_to = "gene",
                 values_to = "expr") %>%
    mutate(clusters_T = factor(clusters_T, levels = rev(cluster_ID_name_ordered))) %>% 
    mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = genes)) %>% 
    group_by(gene) %>%
    mutate(scaled_expr = as.vector(scale(expr))) %>%
    group_by(clusters_T, gene) %>%
    summarise(mean_scaled_expr = mean(expr)) %>%
    mutate(
        color = palette_cluster[as.character(clusters_T)], 
        name = glue::glue("<i style='color:{color}'>{clusters_T}</i>")
    ) %>% 
    mutate(name = fct_reorder(name, as.integer(clusters_T)))
dotplot_df %>% 
    ggplot() +
    aes(gene, name) +
    geom_point(aes(size = mean_scaled_expr, color = mean_scaled_expr)) + 
    labs(caption = "color and size are scaled mean expression; cell types not shown in any particular order here") + 
    scale_color_viridis(limits = c(NA, 3) ,oob = scales::squish) + 
    remove_spines() + 
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(color = "black"), 
          axis.title = element_blank(), 
          legend.position = "none", 
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5), 
          axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown())
```

# How are our groups distributed

## stackedbar

```{r, fig.asp = 2, fig.width = 3}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    calculate_proportion(clusters_T, group) %>% 
    mutate(clusters = factor(clusters_T, levels = cluster_ID_name_ordered)) %>% 
    plot_proportion() + 
    labs(y = "Frequency of Lymphoid") + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_cluster) 
```


```{r, fig.asp = 1, fig.width = 7}
mouse_group_key_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    dplyr::select(mouse, group) %>% 
    unique()
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    calculate_proportion(clusters_T, mouse) %>% 
    left_join(mouse_group_key_df, by = "mouse") %>% 
    mutate(clusters = factor(clusters_T, levels = cluster_ID_name_ordered)) %>% 
    plot_proportion(x = mouse) + 
    facet_wrap(~group, scale = "free_x", ncol = 4) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
    remove_x_spine() + 
    labs(y = "Frequency of Lymphoid") + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_cluster) 
```


```{r, fig.asp = 2, fig.width = 3}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>%

    calculate_proportion(clusters_T, group) %>% 
    mutate(clusters = factor(clusters_T, levels = cluster_ID_name_ordered)) %>% 
    plot_proportion() + 
    labs(y = "Frequency of T/NK") + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_cluster) 
```

## Box plots with stats

```{r}
group_mouse_df <-
    get_metadata_from_so(so,
                         metadata = c("mouse", "hash.ID", "seq", "group"),
                         reduction = NULL) %>%
    select(mouse, group, hash.ID, seq) %>% 
    # mutate(mouse = paste0(mouse, seq)) %>% 
    unique()
prop_df <-
    get_metadata_from_so(so,
                         metadata = c("mouse", "seq", "general_T_subtypes", "clusters_T"),
                         reduction = NULL) %>%
    # mutate(mouse = paste0(mouse, seq)) %>% 
    calculate_proportion(clusters_T, mouse) %>%
    left_join(group_mouse_df, by = "mouse")
```

```{r, fig.asp = 1/2, fig.width = 12}
prop_df %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(group, prop) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_point() + #aes(color = hash.ID, shape = seq)
    labs(y = "Proportion of T cells", 
         caption = "P-values from t tests") +
    stat_compare_means(
        comparisons = prop_df$group %>% unique() %>% combn(m = 2, simplify = F),
        label = "p.signif",
        method = "t.test"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ clusters_T, scale = "free_y", ncol = 6) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = ~ c(0, .[2] * 1.1),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    remove_x_spine() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0.5
    ))
```

# IFNg expression

Where is IFNg expressed in our T cells?

```{r}
ifng_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so, genes = "Ifng") 
plot_umap(ifng_df, color_str = "Ifng", pointsize = 1.5, pixels = c(1024, 1024), 
          x = umap_1, y = umap_2)
plot_violin(ifng_df, group = clusters_T, var = Ifng) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_cluster)
```

```{r, fig.asp = 1.5, fig.width = 4, output-fold=TRUE}
ifng_df %>%
  named_group_split(clusters_T) %>%
  imap( ~ {
    plot_violin(..1, group = group, var = Ifng) +
      geom_jitter(size = 0.1) +
      labs(title = ..2) +
      stat_compare_means(
        comparisons = ifng_df$group %>% unique() %>% combn(m = 2, simplify = F),
        vjust = 1.5,
        label = "p.signif"
      )
  })

```

### Split by genotype

```{r}
dge_fn <- "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets_subsetCD8_WT_cd40-vs-iso.rds"
markers_cd8_cd40.v.iso_wt <- run_or_readRDS(
    file.path(cd8_dir, dge_fn),
    function() {FindMarkers(
        so_cd8 %>% set_idents("genotype"),
        subset.ident = "Ctrl",
        group.by = "treatment",
        ident.1 = "CD40 agonist",
        ident.2 = "Isotype"
    )}
)
dge_fn <- "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets_subsetCD8_B2mKO_cd40-vs-iso.rds"
markers_cd8_cd40.v.iso_b2mKO <- run_or_readRDS(
    file.path(cd8_dir, dge_fn),
    function() {FindMarkers(
        so_cd8 %>% set_idents("genotype"),
        subset.ident = "B2m KO",
        group.by = "treatment",
        ident.1 = "CD40 agonist",
        ident.2 = "Isotype"
    )}
)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
markers_cd8_cd40.v.iso_wt %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
  write_csv(file.path(cd8_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets_subsetCD8_WT_cd40-vs-iso.csv"))
markers_cd8_cd40.v.iso_b2mKO %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
  write_csv(file.path(cd8_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets_subsetCD8_B2mKO_cd40-vs-iso.csv"))
```


```{r}
markers_cd8_cd40.v.iso_wt %>% 
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(avg_log2FC, -log10(p_val_adj)) + 
    geom_scattermore(pointsize = 2.1, pixels = c(1024, 1024)) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(1e-200)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.25, 0.25), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = gene), 
                    data = ~..1 %>% filter(p_val_adj < 1e-200), 
                    max.overlaps = Inf, 
                    size = 3) + 
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1, 
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + 
    labs(caption = "horizontal line drawn -log10(1e-200)", 
         title = "WT: Genes associated with CD40 treatment in CD8+ T cells", 
         subtitle = "CD40 treatment (right) and isotype (left)")
```

## Within CD40 treatment, bw B2m and Ctrl

```{r}
dge_fn <- "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets_subsetCD8_CD40_b2m-vs-wt.rds"
markers_cd8_B2m.vs.wt_Cd40 <- run_or_readRDS(
    file.path(cd8_dir, dge_fn),
    function() {FindMarkers(
        so_cd8 %>% set_idents("treatment"),
        subset.ident = "CD40 agonist",
        group.by = "genotype",
        ident.1 = "B2m KO",
        ident.2 = "Ctrl"
    )}
)
```

```{r}
thresh_b2m <- 1e-200
thresh_wt <- 1e-200
markers_cd8_B2m.vs.wt_Cd40 %>% 
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(avg_log2FC, -log10(p_val_adj)) + 
    geom_scattermore(pointsize = 2.1, pixels = c(1024, 1024)) + 
    annotate("segment", x = -Inf, xend = 0, 
             y = -log10(thresh_wt), yend = -log10(thresh_wt), 
             linetype = "dashed") + 
    annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = Inf, 
             y = -log10(thresh_b2m), yend = -log10(thresh_b2m), 
             linetype = "dashed") + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.25, 0.25), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = gene),
                    data = ~..1 %>% 
                        filter((p_val_adj < thresh_b2m & avg_log2FC > 0) | 
                                   (p_val_adj < thresh_wt & avg_log2FC < 0)),
                    max.overlaps = Inf,
                    size = 3) +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1, 
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + 
    labs(caption = "genes above dashed horizontal lines are labelled", 
         title = "CD40 agonist: Genes associated with B2m KO in CD8+ T cells", 
         subtitle = "B2m KO (right) and WT (left)")
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}

  write_csv(file.path(cd8_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets_subsetCD8_iso_b2m-vs-wt.rds"))
```

## CD40 and isotype

### Split by genotype

```{r}
clusters_T <- so@meta.data$clusters_T %>% unique() %>% set_names()

markers_percluster_cd40.v.iso_wt <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets_percluster_wt_cd40.v.iso.rds"), 
  function() {clusters_T %>%
    map( ~ {
      so_subset <- subset(so %>% set_idents("clusters_T"), idents = ..1)
      FindMarkers(
        so_subset %>% set_idents("genotype"),
        subset.ident = "Ctrl",
        group.by = "treatment",
        ident.1 = "CD40 agonist",
        ident.2 = "Isotype"
      ) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene")
    }) %>%
    list_rbind(names_to = "clusters_T")}
)

markers_percluster_cd40.v.iso_b2m <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets_percluster_b2mko_cd40.v.iso.rds"), 
  function() {clusters_T %>%
    map( ~ {
      so_subset <- subset(so %>% set_idents("clusters_T"), idents = ..1)
      FindMarkers(
        so_subset %>% set_idents("genotype"),
        subset.ident = "B2m KO",
        group.by = "treatment",
        ident.1 = "CD40 agonist",
        ident.2 = "Isotype"
      ) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene")
    }) %>%
    list_rbind(names_to = "clusters_T")}
)
```

```{r}
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(genes)) %>% 
    plot_umap(pointsize = 1.1, x = umap_1, y = umap_2) + 
    facet_wrap(~name)
```

# NK cells

Ccl5 expression in NK cells increases upon CD40 treatment. 

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so, genes = "Ccl5") %>% 
    filter(clusters_T %>% str_detect("NK")) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(genotype, Ccl5, fill = treatment) + 
    geom_violin(scale = "width") + 
    facet_grid(~clusters_T) + 
    remove_x_spine() + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + 
    theme(strip.background = element_blank()) + 
    labs(title = "Ccl5 expression in NK cells increases upon CD40 treatment") 
```
